# account fragment conversion rows. See README.md for tags.
# The harness runs with an empty HOME: no licence key, no account login, no
# network. Rows that need either fail the same way in every mode and are
# tagged no-json; their populated paths (set, add, remove, validate, refresh,
# revalidate, export, import, restore, status with keys, the account lists)
# are covered by TestLicenseEnvelopes, TestAccountEnvelopes and
# TestAccountStatusStates in license_envelope_test.go and json_account_test.go,
# which also assert no fixture key, JWT or token appears in any document.
license
license status
license list
license show #| legacy-json
license clear
license revoke
license migrate
license account status #| legacy-json
license account devices #| legacy-json no-json=needs-an-account-login
license account licenses #| legacy-json no-json=needs-an-account-login
license account team #| legacy-json no-json=needs-an-account-login
license validate #| no-json=needs-a-configured-key
license health #| legacy-json no-json=needs-a-configured-key
license export #| no-json=needs-a-licence-cache
license refresh #| no-json=needs-a-configured-key
license revalidate #| no-json=needs-a-configured-key
license set short #| no-json=refuses-a-malformed-key
license remove nself_fixture #| no-json=no-matching-key
# Not run here: upgrade (opens a browser), login and account login (device-code
# flow), account transfer (prompt) and tail (network stream); the first is
# covered by TestLicenseEnvelopes, the rest are interactive or streams.
license logout #| no-json=interactive-credential-removal
